why.q: Why does the bot need this?
why.a: The chat app hides group messages from bots unless privacy is off. With it on, the bot sees only commands and replies to it.
why.faq.a: With group privacy on, a bot receives only commands, replies to its own messages and messages that mention it. Turning it off lets the bot read every message in the groups it is in.
